finding: New official CMS corroboration and a change-triggered current source check reinforce the Lakewood CCN/address identity and current UCI page/file association. The exact 131,072-byte prefix is unchanged from the retained September 26/27 sample and still declares the Orange address. HCAI license-history evidence separately shows the MRF's 060000148 license suffix is consistent with Lakewood's effective-dated current license beginning 2026-03-07; it is not an Orange-only identity signal. The MRF hospital_address conflict remains: the retained Lakewood-named pointer-linked file sample declares the Orange address, while CMS and UCI's facility page identify the Lakewood campus. No full-file content was retrieved. No disposition change or resolution credit is justified.

license_transition_follow_up_2026_09_29.finding: HCAI LFIS shows Lakewood license 930000046 through 2026-03-06 and license 060000148 effective 2026-03-07. The current HCAI Lakewood policy lookup pairs 060000148 with the Lakewood facility. Thus the April 2026 Lakewood MRF's license_number|CA suffix is supported for Lakewood and is not evidence of an Orange file reassignment.
license_transition_follow_up_2026_09_29.disposition_effect: No disposition change; CCN 050581 remains unresolved solely for its Lakewood-named file's Orange hospital_address field.
